inaugural_issue.rationale: Takes its theme from the journal's own charter subtitle. The Capture Registry (#3) is the founding dataset; The Retrieval Settlement (#64) the historiography; the Attribution Scar (#54) the first forensic specimen; CDI (#117) and SIM (#118) the two standing instruments; Erasure Skew (#157) the measurement program; AI-Native Intellectual Biography (#121) the new genre; Empirical Phenomenology (#120) the method for opaque systems. Founded on visible correction rather than error prevention — so the issue leads with the instruments that make error visible.
inaugural_issue.method: Grouped by title for now. Introductions, editing and standalone deposit to follow.
